title: Linked list basics
learn: nodes & pointers, singly vs doubly, insert/delete, dummy head node, traversal, vs arrays
hook: Reverse Linked List and Merge Two Sorted Lists are two of the most asked easy questions. Linked lists test carefulness more than cleverness: can you rewire pointers without losing the rest of the list?

explain.prompt: Explain how you'd reverse a singly linked list in place, and why a dummy node makes deletions and merges simpler.
keyPoints: walk with prev, cur and next: save next, point cur.next at prev, advance
prev ends at the old tail, which is the new head; O(n) time, O(1) space
a dummy node before the head removes the special case of deleting or inserting at the head
